description: Multiple requests can be sent by a client to sge_qmaster in a single message.
Every such request gets a unique number.
A list of MA_Type is used to return the answers to a multi GDI request.

attributes.name: id
description: Id of the individual request to associate request with result.

attributes.name: objects
description: A list of the requested type containing the result of the request.

attributes.name: answers
description: A list of answers. This can be error, warning or info messages from processing the request.
